title: Bluetooth stutter after cold start
summary: Bluetooth audio stutters and drops within 30 seconds of cold start, requiring manual reconnect. Affects Uconnect 8.4 and Uconnect 5 systems. Most reports occur below 5°C ambient temperature.

title: Android Auto disconnect on highway
summary: Android Auto drops connection at highway speeds above 100 km/h, coinciding with cellular handoffs between towers. USB protocol negotiation times out and session is lost.

title: Uconnect 8.4 freeze during navigation
summary: Head unit freezes completely during active navigation, requiring hard reboot by holding power button for 10+ seconds. Occurs predominantly on routes with dense POI data.

title: OTA update stuck at 83 percent progress
summary: OTA firmware update hangs at 83% and never completes. Vehicle must be towed to dealer for recovery flash. Root cause suspected to be file-system journal corruption during delta-apply phase.

title: CarPlay not recognized after iOS update
summary: Apple CarPlay fails to initialise after iOS 17 update. USB handshake times out; Uconnect shows 'Device not supported'. Workaround is to reset network settings on iPhone.

title: Voice recognition misfire rate above 40 percent
summary: Uconnect voice recognition fails to correctly interpret commands more than 40% of the time in road noise conditions above 70 dB. Wake word detector triggers false positives on radio speech.

title: DAB radio drops signal on tunnel exit
summary: DAB radio fails to recover signal after exiting tunnels. FM fallback does not trigger automatically. Requires manual source switch and back to DAB to restore reception.

title: Backup camera latency exceeds 2 seconds
summary: Rearview camera video feed takes more than 2 seconds to appear after engaging reverse. FMVSS 111 requires display within 2 seconds of reverse engagement. Dealer TSB pending.

title: AC unresponsive when radio is active
summary: HVAC control panel becomes unresponsive for 5–15 seconds when radio is scanning stations or playing high-bitrate streaming audio. CAN bus arbitration conflict suspected between IPC and head unit.

title: Map tile rendering blank after 45 minutes navigation
summary: Navigation map tiles go blank (white rectangles) after approximately 45 minutes of continuous routing. Memory leak in tile cache layer suspected. Restarting navigation app resolves temporarily.

title: Wireless CarPlay drops after phone screen locks
summary: Wireless CarPlay session terminates when the connected iPhone auto-locks its screen. Reconnection requires touching the phone screen and re-initiating from Uconnect menu.

title: Uconnect reboots spontaneously at startup
summary: Head unit spontaneously reboots 1–3 times during first 10 minutes of operation after overnight parking. Watchdog timer not resetting correctly during thermal ramp-up from cold soak.

title: SiriusXM loses channel list after engine restart
summary: SiriusXM channel lineup disappears after engine is restarted. Satellite tuner must re-acquire the channel guide download (takes 2–3 minutes) on every ignition cycle.

title: Bluetooth phone call audio routed to speakers not earpiece
summary: Incoming call audio is unexpectedly broadcast through vehicle speakers instead of the phone earpiece when the call is answered before Bluetooth hand-off completes. Privacy concern in shared spaces.

title: USB audio device not detected after ignition cycle
summary: USB mass-storage audio devices (thumb drives) are not enumerated when plugged in at ignition-on. Requires unplug/replug cycle to be recognised by Uconnect media player.
